payload.title: File:Oligocene bird fossil sites (Carpathian Arc).png
payload.artist_html: Z. M. Nochenski, T. Tomek, T. Szybiak & K. Wertz
payload.credit_html: "A new passerine (Aves: Passeriformes) and three other specimens of Late Oligocene birds from Poland, with a review of all Paleogene birds from the northern part of the Carpathian Arc"
payload.description_html: Oligocene sites of the northern section of the Carpathian Arc (Czech Republic, Poland, Slovakia) that yielded bird remains. Red circles on the map indicate paleontological sites, details of which are provided below. Each circle on the pie chart represents one specimen and is correlated with a site number. Detailed data are available in the original publications. 1, Wola Rafałowska: Passeriformes (1), Bochenski et al., 2013; 2, Pogorzany: Procellariiformes (1), Elzanowski et al., 2012; 3, Sobniów: Galliformes (1), Tomek et al., 2014; 4, Przysietnica: Passeriformes (1), Bochenski et al., 2014a; 5, Hłudno: Passeriformes (1), Bochenski et al., 2014b; 6, Winnica: Apodiformes (1), Bochenski and Bochenski, 2008; Passeriformes (1), Bochenski et al., 2018; 7, Rudawka Rymanowska: Upupiformes (1), Bochenski et al., 2020; Passeriformes (1), Bochenski et al., 2021; 8, Bachów: Aves indet. (1), Bochenski et al., 2010; 9, Jamna Dolna: Passeriformes (1), Bochenski et al., 2011; Upupiformes (1), Mayr et al., 2020; 10, Jamna Dolna 2: Ralloidea (1), Mayr and Bochenski, 2016; Accipitriformes (1), Mayr and Hurum, 2020; Passeriformes (2), present study; Aves incertae sedis (1), Mayr, 2019; Aves indet. (3), Bochenski et al., 2016, present study; 11, Litenčice: Piciformes (1), Mayr and Gregorová, 2012; Procellariiformes (1), Gregorová, 2006; 12, Bystré: Upupiformes (1), Kundrát et al., 2015.
